Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.Distributed research infrastructures (compute, storage, licenses, facilities, scientific instruments and digital services) require transparent usage information to support sustainable operation and fair access. Accounting4NFDI is developing a unified, federated accounting framework for NFDI consortia and services. Based on FAIR principles, the framework will align with EOSC requirements and is intended to become a Base4NFDI service that interoperates with existing infrastructures rather than replacing them. DESY and the University of Freiburg jointly lead the work package "Accounting Framework, Service Concept and Dashboard". At DESY, you will conduct independent scientific and conceptual work on the accounting model, federated service and interface architecture, reporting and dashboard concepts, and their validation across heterogeneous research infrastructures. Your focus will be on developing, evaluating and generalising models and architectural concepts for interoperable research infrastructures.About your role:- Scientifically analyse and abstract hetero­geneous accounting requirements of research infrastructures and develop a unified, resource-oriented accounting and information model- Develop and evaluate a federated service, integration and information architecture for Accounting4NFDI, including concepts and specifications for interoperable APIs and exchange formats- Develop reporting and dashboard concepts based on the accounting framework, including suitable attributes, aggregations and evaluation logic for different stakeholder groups- Methodically validate accounting models, architecture and interface concepts through use cases, Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and integration scenarios, and derive generalisable findings for further development- Document, publish and present scientific and technical results; jobs.occupation: Director Global Procurement Packaging (all genders) (Leiter/in - Einkauf)
jobs.description: Your TasksYour MissionEvery NIVEA can, every Eucerin bottle, every cap, tube and label in our products worldwide passes through the hands of your team. As Director Global Procurement Packaging you own one of Beiersdorf's largest spend areas – approx. €800 million across Europe, the Americas and Asia – with a team of 20 packaging professionals. You shape technology and cost strategy for more than 10 packaging categories, you negotiate with the leading packaging suppliers in the world, and you sit at the table where Beiersdorf's sustainability and innovation agenda is decided.What you will own•  The strategy:  Full accountability for the global Packaging Procurement strategy and the performance of the entire spend – enabling our Win with Care and #BEAT agenda.•  The value:  Driving cost out of our packaging system and value into our products – value engineering, tendering, supplier development and a project pipeline that directly impacts company EBIT.•  The transformation:  Steering the sustainable transformation of our packaging assortment (recycled plastics, aluminum, design-to-sustainability) together with R&D, Operations and the brands.•  Resilience:  Improving supply security in a volatile world – Reducing single-sources, and developing supplier relationships strong enough to carry us through supply crisis.•  The future:  Pushing standardization, digitalization and automation of how we buy – and challenging what our suppliers believe is possible.•  The team:  Leading, developing and inspiring a high-performing global team.Your ProfileWhat you bring• A master's degree in business, supply chain, engineering or another relevant field – and several years of leadership experience in a relevant industry.• Direct material procurement expertise (packaging, raws or 3PM) is a strong plus – genuine curiosity for technology and manufacturing is a must: this role lives in supplier plants, not only in meeting rooms.• Proven leadership: you build teams, develop talent, and perform in a fast-paced, complex environment.• Stakeholder craft: you connect and align from shopfloor to Board, internally and externally.• Strategic drive: you spot opportunities before they are obvious – and act on them.• Fluent English; other languages are a plus.Why this roleFew positions combine this much commercial weight, technical depth and enterprise visibility. You manage a multi-million-Euro system, you work with iconic products, and you shape how one of the world's great consumer brands packages its future. The role reports to the Director Global Procurement Directs.At Beiersdorf, we want to help people feel good about their skin – and our commitment goes far beyond caring for skin. For 140 years, we have developed innovative skin and body care products for well-known brands such as NIVEA, Eucerin, La Prairie, Hansaplast, and Labello. We act according to our purpose, WE CARE BEYOND SKIN, and take responsibility for our consumers, our employees, the environment and society.Behind every brand, every product and every accomplishment are our more than 20,000 employees. It is for them that we live an inclusive culture of respect and trust that is strongly aligned with our values – CARE, COURAGE, SIMPLICITY and TRUST. We also embrace diversity by valuing the uniqueness of each individual and being committed to equal opportunities for all.Additional informationIf you have any questions, please check our application FAQs (http://application%20faq%20%7C%20beiersdorf/) first. If your question is not answered there, feel free to contact our Talent Acquisition Expert Emilia via rc@beiersdorf.com (%20rc@beiersdorf.com) .

jobs.occupation: Account Manager Graphics (m/f/d), Neschen Coating GmbH (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Worldwide Sales & New Business Development Neschen, part of Henkel, develops and manufactures self-adhesive graphic media and coating solutions. Our portfolio includes printable media, protective laminates and mounting films for applications in signage, retail graphics, displays and visual communication. To accelerate our international growth, we are looking for a commercially driven Account Manager with a clear hunter mindset. You enjoy approaching new customers, understanding their applications and turning opportunities into profitable, lasting business. What you will do Win new customers: Identify, approach and win distributors, graphics-material suppliers, print service providers and customers with relevant graphics applications. Engage end customers and specifiers: Build relationships with retailers, brand owners, designers, architects and agencies. Understand their projects, provide advice, samples and application support, and establish Neschen products in material selections and specifications. Turn projects into sales: Work with distributors, print service providers and application partners to convert product selections into orders and repeat business. Develop international markets: Build growth plans for priority markets, recruit suitable distribution partners and expand our portfolio within existing accounts. Lead the sales process: Own every step from prospecting and qualification through trials and commercial proposals to negotiation and closing. Connect customers with our expertise: Work closely with product management, application technology, development and marketing, and bring market feedback back into the company. Deliver profitable growth: Take responsibility for agreed sales, margin and new-business targets, supported by a qualified pipeline and reliable CRM forecasts. What you bring Proven experience in technical B2B sales, with clear examples of winning new customers and developing profitable business A proactive, persistent and results-oriented approach: you start conversations, identify projects and follow through to closing Experience in graphics, visual communication, large-format printing, self-adhesive films, laminates, mounting products or related materials Experience working with distribution partners, end customers and specifiers; an established industry network and experience in securing specifications are an advantage Technical curiosity and an understanding of how material selection affects printing, finishing, installation and application Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills, and the ability to build trust across countries and cultures A structured, independent and collaborative way of working A degree in business, engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Fluent German and English, as you will work with customers and colleagues worldwide; further languages are an advantage Willingness to travel internationally  What we offer An international role with clear responsibility for winning customers and growing Neschen's Graphics business A broad portfolio of graphic media, supported by experienced product and application specialists The chance to influence product selection from the early stages of customer projects The expertise of Neschen in graphic media and coating technologies, and the strength of Henkel behind it A competitive salary package with a performance-related bonus Technical training, professional development and an international team that values initiative, accountability and cooperation. Flexible working hours Attractive benefits under the chemical industry collective agreement, including an employer-funded company pension and long-term care insurance Ready to turn opportunities into business? We value diversity and welcome applications regardless of gender, age, disability, ethnic origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation or gender identity. Applicants with severe disabilities will be given preference if equally qualified.
